exposure: Antenatal corticosteroids (ACS) administration during the late-preterm (LPT) period
outcome: composite respiratory morbidity (RDS, TTN, O2 requirement, CPAP use, or mechanical ventilation)
cohort: 290 women with twin pregnancies resulting in live births of 580 neonates who delivered during the late-preterm period between 2016 and 2018 at a tertiary medical center
finding: Late-preterm ACS administration in twin pregnancies complicated by late-preterm birth did not reduce neonatal respiratory morbidity but was associated with higher rates of hypoglycemia.
mod_finding: This study found that late-preterm corticosteroid administration in twin pregnancies was not associated with a decrease in neonatal respiratory morbidity, and was associated with higher rates of hypoglycemia.
